title: GPU system emitter hoists [i] row reads to main() for the whole dispatch extent (out-of-bounds rows)
body: A [KernelSystem] whose dispatch extent is a texture (TileBinPrepareSystem: the view-depth extent, ~2M invocations at 1080p) and that reads an instance row as recipes[i] (or through a plain alias int instance = i) gets the read hoisted into main() as recipes.values[linearId], executed for every invocation, past the end of the instance rows (undefined without robustBufferAccess), even when the body guards i < instanceCount first. opus-rl0 worked around it with int instance = i % view[0].instanceCount. Fix: hoist an element read only when the extent is the row set, or after the body guard; else keep the buffer access. Tier sol: kernel GLSL emitter change, needs generated-output re-goldens.

title: vixen-native.sh build build on a fresh native tree fails with a bare "not a directory" instead of configuring
body: opus-rl0 (11-17): the first queued regen on a new C:\vixen-native\<lane> tree ran build.bat build <preset> <target>; cmake --build failed with C:/vixen-native/rl0/build/ninja-release is not a directory, reported as BUILD INVOCATION FAILED before any target. Remedy was rerunning with action all. The wrapper knows the tree is fresh (it just cloned it); it should configure first or refuse with the fix named. Also: a lane-local regen helper had to reset the native tree after each target, because sync refuses a dirty tree (opus-rt7 noted the same: the native wrapper should own regen + copy-back). Tier luna: shell glue in tools/vixen-native.sh, port per R812/R821.
